-- Service ID auflösen falls nur Name
SELECT s.id AS service_id, s.name, s.duration_min, s.price_cents, s.category
FROM services s
WHERE s.salon_id = '{{ $json.salon_id }}'
  AND s.is_active = true
  AND (
    s.id::text = '{{ $json.service_id }}'
    OR LOWER(s.name) LIKE LOWER('%{{ $json.service_name }}%')
  )
LIMIT 1;

-- Staff auflösen und prüfen ob Service angeboten wird
SELECT st.id AS staff_id, st.name AS staff_name, st.color
FROM staff st
JOIN staff_services ss ON ss.staff_id = st.id
WHERE st.salon_id = '{{ $('Validiere Anfrage').item.json.salon_id }}'
  AND st.is_active = true
  AND ss.service_id = '{{ $json.service_id }}'
  AND (
    st.id::text = '{{ $('Validiere Anfrage').item.json.staff_id }}'
    OR LOWER(st.name) LIKE LOWER('%{{ $('Validiere Anfrage').item.json.staff_name }}%')
    OR '{{ $('Validiere Anfrage').item.json.staff_name }}' = ''
  )
ORDER BY st.name
LIMIT 5;

-- Freie Slots finden
SELECT slot_start, slot_end
FROM find_available_slots(
  '{{ $('Validiere Anfrage').item.json.salon_id }}'::UUID,
  '{{ $json.staff_id }}'::UUID,
  '{{ $('Validiere Anfrage').item.json.preferred_date }}'::DATE,
  {{ $('DB: Service suchen').item.json.duration_min }}
)
WHERE slot_start::TIME >= '{{ $('Validiere Anfrage').item.json.preferred_time || '09:00' }}'::TIME
ORDER BY slot_start
LIMIT 5;

-- Kunde anlegen oder finden
INSERT INTO clients (salon_id, first_name, phone, email, source, gdpr_consent, gdpr_consent_date)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Validiere Anfrage').item.json.salon_id }}',
  '{{ $('Validiere Anfrage').item.json.client_name }}',
  '{{ $('Validiere Anfrage').item.json.client_phone }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $('Validiere Anfrage').item.json.client_email }}', ''),
  '{{ $('Validiere Anfrage').item.json.source }}',
  true,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (salon_id, phone) DO UPDATE SET
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id AS client_id, first_name, last_name, phone;

-- Termin buchen
INSERT INTO bookings (
  salon_id, client_id, staff_id, service_id,
  start_time, end_time, status, source, price_cents, notes
) VALUES (
  '{{ $('Validiere Anfrage').item.json.salon_id }}',
  '{{ $json.client_id }}',
  '{{ $('DB: Verfügbare Stylisten').item.json.staff_id }}',
  '{{ $('DB: Service suchen').item.json.service_id }}',
  '{{ $('DB: Freie Slots').item.json.slot_start }}',
  '{{ $('DB: Freie Slots').item.json.slot_end }}',
  'confirmed',
  '{{ $('Validiere Anfrage').item.json.source }}',
  {{ $('DB: Service suchen').item.json.price_cents }},
  NULLIF('{{ $('Validiere Anfrage').item.json.notes }}', '')
)
RETURNING id AS booking_id, start_time, end_time;
